answer: An AI-agent economy can deter Sybil attacks via modulated retroreflector attestation. A verifier sweeps a challenge laser across nodes whose enclaves drive corner-cube reflectors to return signed responses using a trellis code. Accepting one identity per resolvable bearing and range bin blocks co-located clones, imposing hardware, power, and line-of-sight site costs per identity. However, mist or glare from wind-driven ripple on a nearby lagoon can scatter the beam and reject valid nodes.
